name: Jarvis
changes_cs: Nastaveni Jarvise uz neukazuje dlouhe vysvetlujici texty pro internet a bezpecnost; tyto informace jsou presunute do tooltipu a dialog je kompaktnejsi.
changes_en: Jarvis Settings no longer shows long explanatory internet/security text; the details moved into tooltips and the dialog is more compact.

history.changes_cs: Nastaveni Jarvise uz neukazuje dlouhe vysvetlujici texty pro internet a bezpecnost; tyto informace jsou presunute do tooltipu a dialog je kompaktnejsi.
history.changes_en: Jarvis Settings no longer shows long explanatory internet/security text; the details moved into tooltips and the dialog is more compact.

history.changes_cs: UI aktualizace Jarvise ted pouziva WDUi dialogy pro kontrolu, stazeni a instalaci a nezapisuje technicky update vystup do chatu.
history.changes_en: Jarvis UI update actions now use WDUi dialogs for check, download, and install progress without writing technical update output into chat.

history.changes_cs: Jarvis odstranil z levého panelu zbytečné tlačítko Správa chatu; akce chatu zůstávají v kontextovém popupu nad chatem, takže sidebar je klidnější.
history.changes_en: Jarvis removed the redundant Chat management button from the left sidebar; chat actions remain available from the chat context popup, keeping the sidebar calmer.

history.changes_cs: Jarvis Setup je ted single-instance a interaktivni instalace, preinstalace i odinstalace bezi pres viditelny prubehovy dialog na worker vlakne, takze opakovane spusteni uz nezamrazi UI a update ceka na starou instanci jen kratce.
history.changes_en: Jarvis Setup is now single-instance, and interactive install, reinstall, and uninstall run through a visible worker-thread progress dialog, so repeated launches no longer freeze the UI and updates wait for the old instance only briefly.

history.changes_cs: Jarvis a sdilene WDUi okno se pri maximalizaci chovaji jako normalni Windows aplikace: respektuji pracovni plochu monitoru a neprekryvaji Windows taskbar.
history.changes_en: Jarvis and the shared WDUi window host now maximize like normal Windows applications: they respect the monitor work area and do not cover the Windows taskbar.

history.changes_cs: Jarvis pri instalaci a odpovedich automaticky pripravuje lokalni Ollama prostredi, umi doplnit Ollamu pres Windows Package Manager, probudit server, stahnout vybrany model a misto technickeho HTTP logu ukazuje lidske shrnuti.
history.changes_en: Jarvis now automatically prepares the local Ollama environment during setup and answers, can install Ollama through Windows Package Manager, wake the server, pull the selected model, and shows a human-readable status instead of raw HTTP diagnostics.

history.changes_cs: Jarvis odstranil duplicitni horni tlacitka Novy chat, Model a Nastaveni; Novy chat zustava vlevo a model/nastaveni zustavaji ve spodnim composeru.
history.changes_en: Jarvis removed duplicate top New chat, Model, and Settings buttons; New chat remains in the sidebar and model/settings remain in the bottom composer.

history.changes_cs: Jarvis pri obrazove priloze po probuzeni lokalniho provideru automaticky vybere Vision profil, vision-capable nakonfigurovany model nebo vision-capable model nahlaseny providerem.
history.changes_en: Jarvis now wakes the local provider for image attachments and automatically chooses the Vision profile, a configured vision-capable model, or a provider-reported vision-capable model.

history.changes_cs: Jarvis Model popup vybira vsechny modelove profily z comboboxu s popisy a obrazove prilohy automaticky preferuji Vision model.
history.changes_en: Jarvis Model popup now selects all model profiles from tooltip-backed comboboxes, and image attachments automatically prefer a Vision model.

history.changes_cs: Jarvis pri obrazove priloze automaticky preferuje Vision model nebo vision-capable profil a Model popup vybira modely z comboboxu s popisem misto rucniho psani.
history.changes_en: Jarvis now automatically prefers a Vision model or vision-capable profile for image attachments, and the Model popup selects models from tooltip-backed comboboxes instead of typed model IDs.

history.changes_cs: Jarvis pri obrazove priloze automaticky preferuje Vision model nebo vision-capable profil a modelove nastaveni pridava samostatny Vision profil.
history.changes_en: Jarvis now automatically prefers a Vision model or vision-capable profile for image attachments, and model settings include a dedicated Vision profile.

history.changes_cs: Jarvis posila bezny chat pres lokalni model s recentnim kontextem a pri Ollama provideru se pokusi automaticky probudit lokalni model server pred odpovedi.
history.changes_en: Jarvis now sends ordinary chat through the local model with recent conversation context and attempts to auto-start the Ollama local model server before replying.

history.changes_cs: Chat po dokonceni prace sbali Jarvisovy pracovni komentare do rozklikavaciho souhrnu, aby konverzace zustala prehledna.
history.changes_en: After a job finishes, Jarvis collapses work progress comments into an expandable summary so the chat stays clean.

history.changes_cs: Pridava vychozi pracovni slozku pro chaty bez projektu. Jarvis ted pouziva Documents\\Jarvis jako viditelny sandbox, kdyz chat nema konkretni projektovou slozku.
history.changes_en: Adds a default workspace for chats without a project. Jarvis now uses Documents\\Jarvis as a visible sandbox when a chat has no concrete project folder.

history.changes_cs: Pridava obrazky v chatu: Ctrl+V/vyber souboru, lokalni ulozeni, vision payload pro Ollama a LM Studio. Kontextove menu chatu se zavira klikem mimo nej.
history.changes_en: Adds chat image attachments: Ctrl+V/file picker, local storage, vision payloads for Ollama and LM Studio. Chat context popup now closes when clicking outside.

history.changes_cs: Jarvis odpovida na kratke pozdravy lokalne jeste pred routerem a modelem, takze Ahoj funguje i kdyz Ollama nebo jiny lokalni model server zrovna nebezi. Dokumentace zaroven upresnuje pravidlo chat-first agenta: Jarvis ma pusobit jako normalni chat s agentickymi schopnostmi pod nim.
history.changes_en: Jarvis now answers short greetings locally before router and model work, so Ahoj works even when Ollama or another local model server is not running. The documentation also clarifies the chat-first agent rule: Jarvis should feel like a normal chat with agent capabilities underneath.

history.changes_cs: Chat a stav Jarvise uz neukazuji router/model/HTTP detaily; technicke worker vystupy se filtruji a selhani modelu se zobrazi lidsky.
history.changes_en: Jarvis chat and status no longer show router/model/HTTP details; technical worker output is filtered and model failures are shown in plain human wording.

history.changes_cs: Chat uz nevykresluje technicke hlavičky Antonin/Jarvis; uzivatelske zpravy jsou bubliny s casem a Jarvisovy komentare pusobi jako prirozena konverzace.
history.changes_en: Chat no longer renders raw Antonin/Jarvis headers; user prompts are bubbles with time labels and Jarvis work comments read like natural conversation.

history.changes_cs: Rychle akce spravy chatu jsou dostupne pravym klikem na chat v levem panelu.
history.changes_en: Chat management quick actions are available by right-clicking a chat in the left sidebar.

history.changes_cs: Sprava chatu: aktivni chat se obnovi po restartu, prazdny novy chat zustava docasny, chaty lze prejmenovat, pripnout, archivovat, obnovit nebo smazat a priradit k projektu jako workspace sandbox.
history.changes_en: Chat management: the active chat is restored after restart, empty new chats stay temporary, and chats can be renamed, pinned, archived, restored or deleted, and assigned to a project workspace sandbox.

history.changes_cs: Jarvis opravuje obnovu okna z tray: uklada samostatne maximalizovany stav, pri otevreni z tray ho obnovi a starsi ulozenou geometrii okna pri updatu bezpecne zmigruje bez mazani modelu, projektu nebo chatu. CPM/WDUi pravidla a sablona ted vyzaduji stejne chovani pro nove Win32/C++ WDUi tray aplikace.
history.changes_en: Jarvis fixes tray window restore: it now saves maximized state separately, restores it when opened from the tray, and safely migrates older saved window geometry during update without deleting models, projects, or chats. CPM/WDUi rules and the durable template now require the same behavior for new Win32/C++ WDUi tray apps.

history.changes_cs: Jarvis opravuje obnovu okna z tray: ulozi samostatne maximalizovany stav, pri otevreni z tray ho obnovi a starsi ulozenou geometrii okna pri updatu bezpecne zmigruje bez mazani modelu, projektu nebo chatu. CPM/WDUi pravidla a sablona ted vyzaduji stejne chovani pro nove Win32/C++ WDUi tray aplikace.
history.changes_en: Jarvis fixes tray window restore: it now saves maximized state separately, restores it when opened from the tray, and safely migrates older saved window geometry during update without deleting models, projects, or chats. CPM/WDUi rules and the durable template now require the same behavior for new Win32/C++ WDUi tray apps.

history.changes_cs: Vychozi skin Jarvise je Codex Forge. Ciste instalace a konfigurace ted startuji s WDUi skinem Codex Forge, ulozena uzivatelska volba skinu zustava zachovana.
history.changes_en: Jarvis now defaults to the Codex Forge skin. Clean installs and fresh configs start with the WDUi Codex Forge skin while existing saved user skin choices remain respected.

history.changes_cs: Jarvis pri praci ukazuje kratke lidske prubezne komentare, spodní composer ma stop tlacitko a pri bezici praci umi poslat novou zpravu jako prioritni dalsi pokyn pred cekajici frontu.
history.changes_en: Jarvis now shows short human-readable progress comments while working, adds a bottom stop control, and can send a new message as the next priority instruction ahead of the waiting queue while work is running.

history.changes_cs: Systemove dialogy Jarvise maji scrollovatelný lidsky citelny obsah; projektovy intake uz neukazuje logovy dry-run dump, ale kratke shrnuti, dalsi krok a citelny seznam podkladu.
history.changes_en: Jarvis system dialogs now use scrollable human-readable content; project intake no longer shows a dry-run log dump and instead presents a short summary, next step, and readable source list.

history.changes_cs: Bezpecnostni nastaveni Jarvise ma nove Codex-like volby Pozadat o schvaleni, Schvalit za me, Plny pristup a Vlastni, napojene na internet/extension policy brany.
history.changes_en: Jarvis security settings now expose Codex-like presets: Ask for approval, Approve for me, Full access, and Custom, wired to the internet and extension policy gates.

history.changes_cs: Jarvis je ted opravdovy tray companion pri startu s Windows: Startup zastupce pouziva --start-hidden, aplikace se po prihlaseni schova rovnou do tray a uvodni chat se zalozi az pri otevreni okna.
history.changes_en: Jarvis now behaves as a true tray companion on Windows startup: the Startup shortcut uses --start-hidden, the app starts directly in the tray after sign-in, and the initial chat is created only when the window is opened.

history.changes_cs: Kliknuti na systemove a UI akce Jarvise uz nevklada jejich vystupy do chatove konverzace; vysledky se zobrazuji v dialozich nebo stavovem UI.
history.changes_en: Jarvis UI and system actions triggered by clicks no longer write their output into the chat transcript; results are shown in dialogs or status UI instead.

history.changes_cs: Jarvis setup updater ted pred MSI instalaci zavira bezici Jarvis.exe stejne jako ostatni WDUi aplikace, takze update nezustane viset na stare instanci.
history.changes_en: Jarvis setup updater now closes running Jarvis.exe instances before MSI installation like the other WDUi apps, so update handoff no longer depends on the old instance exiting by itself.

history.changes_cs: Zmenseny kompatibilni ADPU update manifest a presunuta vetsi lokalizovana release metadata do update-data.zip, aby update fungoval i ze starsich verzi Jarvise.
history.changes_en: Shrinks the compatible ADPU update manifest and moves larger localized release metadata into update-data.zip so updates work from older Jarvis builds.

history.changes_cs: Levy postranni panel pro novy chat, hledani v projektu, pluginy, frontu prace, vyber projektu, podklady, posledni chaty a nastaveni. Hledani a projektovy start se v transkriptu zobrazuji jako bezna konverzace, ne jako prikazy.
history.changes_en: Adds a left sidebar for new chat, project search, plugins, work queue, project picker, sources, recent chats, and settings. Search and project start now appear as normal conversation entries instead of exposing command syntax.

history.changes_cs: Jarvis pouziva stejnou update ikonku jako ostatni WDUi aplikace. Update badge v titulku ted nacita zabalene PNG assety pro kontrolu i dostupnou aktualizaci a setup je instaluje spolu s aplikaci.
history.changes_en: Jarvis now uses the same update icon style as the other WDUi apps. The title-bar update badge loads packaged PNG assets for check and update-available states, and setup installs them with the app.

history.changes_cs: Jarvis pocita model-fit s dedikovanou VRAM i konzervativnim kreditem ze sdilene GPU/system pameti. /hardware ukazuje dedicated, shared a effective GPU memory, aby iGPU/UMA stroje nebyly podhodnocene.
history.changes_en: Jarvis now estimates model fit with dedicated VRAM plus a conservative credit from shared GPU/system memory. /hardware shows dedicated, shared, and effective GPU memory so iGPU/UMA machines are not undercounted.

history.changes_cs: Jarvis ma verejny internet ve vychozim Standard profilu, Nastaveni popup pro povoleni/vypnuti internetu a bezpecnostni profil, a update jde spustit z Nastaveni nebo update badge bez hledani prikazu.
history.changes_en: Jarvis now enables public internet by default in the Standard profile, adds a Settings popup for internet/security profile control, and lets users check or install updates from Settings or the update badge without discovering commands.

history.changes_cs: Jarvis ma klidnejsi chat/project shell, skryty Model popup s rezimy Auto/Rychle/Programovani/Premysleni, skryte nastaveni jazyka a vzhledu a zjednodusene menu Aplikace bez prikazoveho katalogu.
history.changes_en: Jarvis now has a calmer chat/project shell, a hidden Model popup with Auto/Fast/Coding/Reasoning modes, hidden language and appearance settings, and a simplified Application menu without a command catalog.

history.changes_cs: Jarvis ma chat-first vstup bez command dumpu a nove Pridat popup akce pro bezne uzivatele.
history.changes_en: Jarvis now has a chat-first prompt without command dump text and new Add popup actions for ordinary users.

history.changes_cs: Jarvis je vedeny jako obecny lokalni agent pro bezne lidi a pribyl read-only Project intake workflow.
history.changes_en: Jarvis is now documented as a general local agent for ordinary users and adds a read-only Project intake workflow.

history.changes_cs: Srovnan publikacni kontrakt Jarvise: ADPU manifest, setup a checksum se znovu vydaly z aktualniho CPM buildu, aby audit dokazal overit shodu verze a publikovanych artefaktu.
history.changes_en: Aligned the Jarvis publication contract: the ADPU manifest, setup, and checksum were republished from the current CPM build so the audit can verify version and published artifact consistency.

history.changes_cs: Jarvis 0.1.172 pridava read-only extension executor result-observation runtime execution result-runtime execution-result runtime-contract checkpoint. Novy prikaz a manager tlacitko zapisuji contract-only boundary po implementation-gate kroku; runtime, proces, capture, replay, resume, tool invocation a context transfer zustavaji blokovane.
history.changes_en: Jarvis 0.1.172 adds a read-only extension executor result-observation runtime execution result-runtime execution-result runtime-contract checkpoint. The new command and manager button record a contract-only boundary after the implementation-gate step; runtime, process, capture, replay, resume, tool invocation, and context transfer remain blocked.

history.changes_cs: Jarvis 0.1.171 pridava read-only extension executor result-observation runtime execution result-runtime execution-result implementation-gate checkpoint. Novy prikaz a manager tlacitko zapisuji implementation-gate boundary po owner-review kroku; runtime, proces, capture, replay, resume, tool invocation a context transfer zustavaji blokovane.
history.changes_en: Jarvis 0.1.171 adds a read-only extension executor result-observation runtime execution result-runtime execution-result implementation-gate checkpoint. The new command and manager button record an implementation-gate boundary after the owner-review step; runtime, process, capture, replay, resume, tool invocation, and context transfer remain blocked.
